content_blocks.label: clause_1._REASONS_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: The TENANT has failed to comply with the terms of the lease agreement by non-payment of rent.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_NOTICE_PERIOD
content_blocks.text: The TENANT is given thirty (30) days from the date of this notice to vacate the premises.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._ACTION_TO_BE_TAKEN
content_blocks.text: If the TENANT does not vacate the premises within the specified period, legal action will be initiated.
